item.title: Contratto di ricerca: Circular economy practices in agrifood value chains and food aid systems - 2026_CDR_DIG_11 (Politecnico MILANO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-18 12:00
Institution: Politecnico MILANO, Milan
Field: Industrial and information engineering / 09/IEGE-01 Ingegneria economico-gestionale

The research programme aims to investigate circular economy practices and models developed by companies along the agri-food value chain. In particular, it examines the benefits generated by the collaborative food aid system, based on donations of surplus food and standard products, for food processing and retail companies that donate products to Food Banks in Italy. The research also seeks to build a robust evidence base to assess the economic and material value, as well as the social effects, generated by local organizations affiliated with Banco Alimentare and engaged in food recovery and redistribution activities.

item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-25 23:59

Field: Industrial and information engineering / 09/ICHI-01 Sistemi, metodi e tecnologie dell'ingegneria chimica e di processo

This research activity focuses on the experimental characterization and modeling of ion-exchange membranes to assess physicochemical and transport properties. The experimental phase involves investigating key parameters such as ionic conductivity, osmotic water flux, permselectivity, and chemical stability under diverse operational conditions. In parallel, advanced theoretical and numerical models based on Stephan-Maxwell approach have to be developed and validated against experimental data to simulate mass transport mechanisms and predict membrane behavior. item.title: Contratto di ricerca: Design and evaluation of a blood pump to support the Fontan circulation - 2026_CDR_DCMC_5 (Politecnico MILANO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-03 12:00
Institution: Politecnico MILANO, Milan
Field: Industrial and information engineering / 09/IBIO-01 Bioingegneria

Single ventricle defects are among the most severe forms of congenital heart disease and are palliated through a series of surgeries culminating in the Fontan procedure. Although patient survival is substantially improved, progressive circulatory failure may develop over time, requiring heart support. However, current ventricular assist devices are poorly suited to the unique physiology of the Fontan circulation. To address this unmet clinical need, this project will investigate the feasibility of a minimally invasive pump designed for chronic Fontan support without requiring additional open-heart surgery. Computational modelling will be used to: i) develop the structural design of a…

item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-03 12:00
Institution: Politecnico MILANO, Milan
Field: Industrial and information engineering / 09/IBIO-01 Bioingegneria

This project aims to develop a non-invasive, screen-independent EEG communication system for people with ALS who struggle with speech, movement, or eye-tracking tools. It will detect intentional attempts to communicate through imagined words or short phrases and identify messages from a personalized vocabulary of around 20 essential expressions. A constrained AI assistant will manage uncertainty, request confirmation, offer alternatives, and convey confirmed messages while keeping users in control.
